source: 之之 P2 答题骨架五段句型库（design/16）。顺序=P2 答题思考顺序，练完一类即掌握骨架一环。focus 沿用弱点标签体系供薄弱条映射；scene[] 为跨话题换场景巩固题（题干只给中文，禁只换一个名词）。词汇按 5.5 口径从简。

sentences.cn: 我想聊聊厦门的一个安静地方。
sentences.right: I'd like to talk about a quiet place in Xiamen.
sentences.formula: I'd like to talk about + 名词
sentences.note: 开门第一句万能句，任何话题直接套；like to 后用原形，别说 to talking。

scene.cn: 我想聊聊一本叫《小王子》的书。
scene.right: I'd like to talk about a book called The Little Prince.

scene.cn: 我想聊聊我最好的朋友。
scene.right: I'd like to talk about my best friend.

sentences.cn: 我打算讲讲上个月我和家人的一次旅行。
sentences.right: I'm going to talk about a trip with my family last month.
sentences.formula: I'm going to talk about + 名词
sentences.note: 与「I'd like to」互换；过去的时间放句尾交代。

scene.cn: 我打算讲讲我最喜欢的一个手机游戏。
scene.right: I'm going to talk about my favourite mobile game.

scene.cn: 我打算讲讲我们的旧家庭轿车。
scene.right: I'm going to talk about our old family car.

sentences.cn: 我想描述的那个人是我的舅舅。
sentences.right: The person I'd like to describe is my uncle.
sentences.formula: The + 名词 + I'd like to describe is ...
sentences.note: 人物类话题专用开头，把「人/地方/东西」换掉就能迁移。

scene.cn: 我想描述的那个地方是我的大学。
scene.right: The place I'd like to describe is my university.

scene.cn: 我想描述的那样东西是我的旧手机。
scene.right: The thing I'd like to describe is my old phone.

sentences.cn: 说到放松，我想讲讲我家附近的一个公园。
sentences.right: When it comes to relaxing, I'd like to talk about a park near my home.
sentences.formula: When it comes to + 名词/doing, ...
sentences.note: 「说到…」引出话题，P1/P2 都能用；to 是介词，动词要加 -ing。

scene.cn: 说到美食，我想讲讲我妈做的面条。
scene.right: When it comes to food, I'd like to talk about the noodles made by my mom.

scene.cn: 说到运动，我想讲讲打羽毛球。
scene.right: When it comes to sports, I'd like to talk about playing badminton.

sentences.cn: 我最喜欢的家乡美食是红烧肉。
sentences.right: My favourite food in my hometown is braised pork.
sentences.formula: My favourite + 名词 + is ...
sentences.note: 直给型开头，最简单不慌；别漏 is。

scene.cn: 我最喜欢的消遣是玩游戏。
scene.right: My favourite pastime is playing games.

scene.cn: 我最喜欢的城市是杭州。
scene.right: My favourite city is Hangzhou.

sentences.cn: 今天我想告诉你一段有趣的经历。
sentences.right: Today I want to tell you about an interesting experience.
sentences.formula: I want to tell you about + 名词
sentences.note: 经历类话题（一次经历/一天/一件事）开头；tell sb about sth，中间不加 to。

scene.cn: 今天我想告诉你我的一个爱好。
scene.right: Today I want to tell you about one of my hobbies.

scene.cn: 今天我想告诉你我们学校的一个活动。
scene.right: Today I want to tell you about an activity at my school.

sentences.cn: 它位于厦门的海边。
sentences.right: It's located by the sea in Xiamen.
sentences.formula: It's located in/by + 地点
sentences.note: 地点类第二句交代位置；located 前必须有个 It's。

scene.cn: 它位于城市的中心。
scene.right: It's located in the centre of the city.

scene.cn: 它位于我家附近。
scene.right: It's located near my home.

sentences.cn: 它离我家大约二十分钟路程。
sentences.right: It's about twenty minutes from my home.
sentences.formula: It's about + 时间/距离 + from ...
sentences.note: 交代远近，数字随便换；别漏 It's。

scene.cn: 它离我们学校步行大约十分钟。
scene.right: It's about ten minutes' walk from my school.

scene.cn: 它离市中心大约五公里。
scene.right: It's about five kilometres from the city centre.

sentences.cn: 我第一次去那儿是在我十岁的时候。
sentences.right: I first went there when I was ten.
sentences.formula: I first went there when + 过去从句
sentences.note: 交代第一次接触的时间点；when 从句也要过去式。

scene.cn: 我第一次读它是在初中的时候。
scene.right: I first read it when I was in junior high school.

scene.cn: 我第一次见到他是在两年前。
scene.right: I first met him two years ago.

sentences.cn: 那是一个能让人放松的地方。
sentences.right: It's a place where you can relax.
sentences.formula: It's a place where + 主语 + can + 原形
sentences.note: 万能背景句，地点类通吃；别漏 It's。

scene.cn: 那是一个能吃到地道当地菜的地方。
scene.right: It's a place where you can eat real local food.

scene.cn: 那是一个能安静读书的地方。
scene.right: It's a place where you can read quietly.

sentences.cn: 它看起来现代又干净。
sentences.right: It looks modern and clean.
sentences.formula: It looks/looked + 形容词（+ and + 形容词）
sentences.note: 外观描写；look 后用形容词；讲过去用 looked。

scene.cn: 它看起来旧但很温馨。
scene.right: It looks old but warm.

scene.cn: 那座建筑当时看起来非常高。
scene.right: That building looked very tall.

sentences.cn: 里面有一个大湖和很多树。
sentences.right: There is a big lake and many trees in it.
sentences.formula: There is/are + 名词 + 地点
sentences.note: 「里面有…」句式；is/are 看靠近的第一个名词。

scene.cn: 里面有很多好玩的设施。
scene.right: There are many fun facilities in it.

scene.cn: 那时候那儿几乎没有人。
scene.right: There were almost no people there.

sentences.cn: 我记得我们沿着湖边走了很久。
sentences.right: I remember that we walked along the lake for a long time.
sentences.formula: I remember that + 主语 + 过去式
sentences.note: 经历类万能叙事句；remember 后从句也要过去式。

scene.cn: 我记得我们拍了很多照片。
scene.right: I remember that we took a lot of photos.

scene.cn: 我记得他笑了很久。
scene.right: I remember that he laughed for a long time.

sentences.cn: 我们在那儿做的事就是拍照和野餐。
sentences.right: What we did there was take photos and have a picnic.
sentences.formula: What ... did was + 动词原形
sentences.note: 强调「做的事」；was 后直接原形，不加 to 也不用过去式。

scene.cn: 我上周做的事就是复习考试。
scene.right: What I did last week was review for my exam.

scene.cn: 我们在那儿做的事就是逛街和吃小吃。
scene.right: What we did there was go shopping and eat snacks.

sentences.cn: 我们在那儿待了整整一个下午。
sentences.right: We spent a whole afternoon there.
sentences.formula: 主语 + spent + 时间 + (doing) + 地点
sentences.note: spend + 时间 + doing；讲过去用 spent。

scene.cn: 我花了两个小时完成作业。
scene.right: I spent two hours finishing my homework.

scene.cn: 我们在那儿待了三天。
scene.right: We spent three days there.

sentences.cn: 之后我们去了一家小餐馆吃晚饭。
sentences.right: After that, we went to a small restaurant for dinner.
sentences.formula: After that, + 主语 + 过去式
sentences.note: 叙事衔接句，把经历串成时间线；After that 后面最容易滑回现在时。

scene.cn: 之后我们坐公交回了家。
scene.right: After that, we took a bus home.

scene.cn: 之后我给她发了一条消息。
scene.right: After that, I sent her a message.

sentences.cn: 我第一次尝试了攀岩。
sentences.right: I tried rock climbing for the first time.
sentences.formula: 主语 + tried + 名词/doing + for the first time
sentences.note: 「第一次…」经历句，自带新鲜感内容。

scene.cn: 我第一次尝了那个菜。
scene.right: I tried that dish for the first time.

scene.cn: 我第一次独自坐了飞机。
scene.right: I took a plane alone for the first time.

sentences.cn: 到那儿花了我大约一个小时。
sentences.right: It took me about an hour to get there.
sentences.formula: It took + 人 + 时间 + to do
sentences.note: 交代耗时；句尾 to do 别漏 to。

scene.cn: 完成这项任务花了我两天。
scene.right: It took me two days to finish the task.

scene.cn: 说服他花了我很长时间。
scene.right: It took me a long time to convince him.

sentences.cn: 最打动我的是那里的安静。
sentences.right: What impressed me most was the quietness there.
sentences.formula: What impressed me most was + 名词
sentences.note: 感受链起点，强调最深的印象；was 后接名词短语。

scene.cn: 最打动我的是他的耐心。
scene.right: What impressed me most was his patience.

scene.cn: 最打动我的是那里的美食。
scene.right: What impressed me most was the food there.

sentences.cn: 站上山顶的时候我特别兴奋。
sentences.right: I felt really excited when I stood on the top.
sentences.formula: 主语 + felt + 形容词 + when 从句
sentences.note: feel 后用形容词，不是副词。

scene.cn: 考完试的时候我特别放松。
scene.right: I felt really relaxed after the exam.

scene.cn: 收到礼物的时候我特别开心。
scene.right: I felt really happy when I got the gift.

sentences.cn: 那次经历让我变得更自信了。
sentences.right: That experience made me feel more confident.
sentences.formula: ... made me feel + 形容词
sentences.note: 「让某人感到…」；feel 后形容词（relaxed，不是 relax）。

scene.cn: 那部电影让我很感动。
scene.right: That movie made me feel touched.

scene.cn: 他的话让我很难过。
scene.right: His words made me feel sad.

sentences.cn: 我以前很怕当众说话，但现在不怕了。
sentences.right: I used to be afraid of speaking in public, but now I'm not.
sentences.formula: 主语 + used to + 原形, but now ...
sentences.note: 感受链「以前→现在」对比句；used to 后用原形。

scene.cn: 我以前不喜欢运动，但现在每周都跑步。
scene.right: I used to dislike sports, but now I run every week.

scene.cn: 我以前住在乡下，但现在住在城市。
scene.right: I used to live in the countryside, but now I live in the city.

sentences.cn: 那是我第一次独自出远门。
sentences.right: It was the first time I travelled far alone.
sentences.formula: It was the first time + 主语 + 过去式
sentences.note: 强调「第一次」的感受背景；从句用过去式。

scene.cn: 那是我第一次做演讲。
scene.right: It was the first time I gave a speech.

scene.cn: 那是我第一次见到海。
scene.right: It was the first time I saw the sea.

sentences.cn: 说实话，我当时累坏了但很开心。
sentences.right: To be honest, I was tired but happy at that time.
sentences.formula: To be honest, I was + 形容词（+ but + 形容词）
sentences.note: 口语化坦白句，自然不背稿；讲过去用 was。

scene.cn: 说实话，我当时特别紧张。
scene.right: To be honest, I was really nervous.

scene.cn: 说实话，那里比我想的更美。
scene.right: To be honest, it was more beautiful than I thought.

sentences.cn: 如果有机会，我一定会再去一次。
sentences.right: If I have a chance, I will definitely go there again.
sentences.formula: If I + 现在时, I will + 原形
sentences.note: 万能收尾；if 从句用现在时，主句才用 will。

scene.cn: 如果有时间，我会再读一遍这本书。
scene.right: If I have time, I will read this book again.

scene.cn: 如果他来杭州，我会带他逛西湖。
scene.right: If he comes to Hangzhou, I will show him around the West Lake.

sentences.cn: 所以我认为那个地方值得一去。
sentences.right: So I think that place is worth visiting.
sentences.formula: ... be worth + doing
sentences.note: worth 后直接 doing，不加 to。

scene.cn: 我认为这本书值得一读。
scene.right: I think this book is worth reading.

scene.cn: 我认为这个习惯值得保持。
scene.right: I think this habit is worth keeping.

sentences.cn: 我很期待下次再去那儿。
sentences.right: I'm looking forward to going there again.
sentences.formula: ... look forward to + doing
sentences.note: 展望句；这里的 to 是介词，后面用 doing——中国学生最高频错误之一。

scene.cn: 我很期待见到我的笔友。
scene.right: I'm looking forward to meeting my pen friend.

scene.cn: 我很期待下个月的假期。
scene.right: I'm looking forward to the holiday next month.

sentences.cn: 所以如果你去那儿，千万别错过那个湖。
sentences.right: So if you go there, don't miss the lake.
sentences.formula: If you ..., don't + 原形
sentences.note: 推荐型收尾，给考官一个具体画面；祈使否定 don't 后用原形。

scene.cn: 如果你尝它，别加糖。
scene.right: If you try it, don't add sugar.

scene.cn: 如果你去看它，别忘了带相机。
scene.right: If you go to see it, don't forget your camera.

sentences.cn: 总之，那是一次难忘的旅行。
sentences.right: All in all, it was an unforgettable trip.
sentences.formula: All in all, it was + 形容词 + 名词
sentences.note: 总结收尾；过去的经历用 was。

scene.cn: 总之，那是一顿很棒的晚餐。
scene.right: All in all, it was a wonderful dinner.

scene.cn: 总之，他是一位好老师。
scene.right: All in all, he is a good teacher.

sentences.cn: 我希望有一天能带我爸妈去那儿。
sentences.right: I hope I can take my parents there one day.
sentences.formula: I hope I can + 原形 + one day
sentences.note: 展望型收尾，未来感强；can 后直接原形。

scene.cn: 我希望有一天能住在海边。
scene.right: I hope I can live by the sea one day.

scene.cn: 我希望明年能通过考试。
scene.right: I hope I can pass the exam next year.
